_comment: One signature record per /errors/ page. HARD maintenance rule: every new error page must add an entry here or the Error Log Analyzer falls behind the cluster. pattern is a case-insensitive JS RegExp source string.

signatures.label: cannot use x (variable of type T) as type U in assignment
signatures.pattern: cannot use .{0,60}? \(variable of type|cannot use .{0,60}? \(type .{0,40}?\) as type

signatures.label: missing go.sum entry for module providing package X
error[E0425]: cannot find value 'x' in this scope
signatures.pattern: E0425|cannot find value .{0,60}? in this scope

signatures.label: error[E0502]: cannot borrow 'x' as mutable because it is also borrowed as immutable
signatures.pattern: E0502|cannot borrow .{0,40}? as mutable because it is also borrowed as immutable

signatures.label: error[E0433]: failed to resolve: use of undeclared crate or module
Error: Could not find or load main class X
signatures.pattern: could not find or load main class

signatures.label: AbortError: The operation was aborted
TypeError: Assignment to constant variable
InvalidCharacterError: Failed to execute 'atob'
signatures.pattern: InvalidCharacterError|failed to execute 'atob'|string to be decoded is not correctly encoded

signatures.label: SyntaxError: Bad control character in string literal in JSON
signatures.pattern: bad control character in string literal

signatures.label: TypeError: Do not know how to serialize a BigInt
signatures.pattern: do not know how to serialize a bigint

signatures.label: ReferenceError: Cannot access 'X' before initialization
TypeError: Cannot convert undefined or null to object
signatures.pattern: cannot convert undefined or null to object

signatures.label: Error: Cannot find module (MODULE_NOT_FOUND)
TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'X')
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'X')
TypeError: Cannot set properties of undefined (setting 'X')
SyntaxError: Cannot use import statement outside a module
signatures.pattern: cannot use import statement outside a module

signatures.label: CORS policy: No 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' header is present
CORS: Response to preflight request doesn't pass access control check
signatures.pattern: response to preflight request does\s?n.?.?t pass access control check|preflight.*access control check

signatures.label: CORS: Request header field is not allowed by Access-Control-Allow-Headers
signatures.pattern: request header field .{0,40}? is not allowed by access-control-allow-headers|is not allowed by access-control-allow-headers

signatures.label: Error: error:0308010C:digital envelope routines::unsupported
Docker: standard_init_linux.go — exec format error
Docker: Cannot connect to the Docker daemon
signatures.pattern: [Cc]annot connect to the [Dd]ocker daemon|[Ii]s the docker daemon running

signatures.label: Docker: Container exited with code 137 (OOMKilled)
Docker: permission denied connecting to the daemon socket
signatures.pattern: permission denied while trying to connect to the Docker daemon socket|docker\.sock: connect: permission denied

signatures.label: Docker: no space left on device
Docker: container name is already in use
signatures.pattern: [Cc]onflict\. The container name .* is already in use|is already in use by container

signatures.label: Docker: executable file not found in $PATH
signatures.pattern: executable file not found in \$PATH|OCI runtime create failed

signatures.label: Docker: port is already allocated
Error: listen EADDRINUSE: address already in use
Error: read ECONNRESET / socket hang up
net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED
net::ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED
json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Expecting property name enclosed in double quotes
signatures.pattern: expecting property name enclosed in double quotes

signatures.label: error: externally-managed-environment
TypeError: Failed to construct 'URL': Invalid URL
TypeError: Failed to fetch
fatal error: all goroutines are asleep - deadlock!
panic: runtime error: index out of range [N] with length M
signatures.pattern: panic:.{0,40}?index out of range|index out of range \[\d+\] with length

signatures.label: json: cannot unmarshal string into Go value of type int
signatures.pattern: json: cannot unmarshal|cannot unmarshal .{0,40}? into go value

signatures.label: panic: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference
gyp ERR! build error
IndentationError: unexpected indent
Exception in thread "main" java.lang.NullPointerException
FATAL ERROR: JavaScript heap out of memory
TypeError: the JSON object must be str, bytes or bytearray, not dict
signatures.pattern: the JSON object must be str, bytes or bytearray

signatures.label: Why JSON.stringify drops a property (undefined, functions, symbols)
json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)
json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Extra data: line 1 column N (char N)
json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Unterminated string starting at
JsonWebTokenError: invalid signature & jwt malformed
KeyError in Python
RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded
Mixed Content: was loaded over HTTPS, but requested an insecure resource
Module not found: Can't resolve 'fs'
signatures.pattern: module not found: can.?t resolve|can.?t resolve '(?:fs|path|crypto|os|stream)'

signatures.label: net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT
net::ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID
net::ERR_CONNECTION_TIMED_OUT
net::ERR_INTERNET_DISCONNECTED
net::ERR_SSL_PROTOCOL_ERROR
net::ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS
AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'X'
TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not subscriptable
npm ERR! code EACCES: permission denied
npm ERR! code ERESOLVE — unable to resolve dependency tree
TypeError: Object of type datetime is not JSON serializable
signatures.pattern: object of type .{0,40}? is not json serializable|is not json serializable

signatures.label: ERROR: deadlock detected
duplicate key value violates unique constraint
signatures.pattern: duplicate key value violates unique constraint

signatures.label: FATAL: sorry, too many clients already
process.env.X is undefined
RangeError: Invalid array length
ReferenceError: process is not defined
ReferenceError: require is not defined in ES module scope
TypeError: body stream already read
error[E0382]: borrow of moved value
error[E0499]: cannot borrow as mutable more than once
signatures.pattern: E0499|cannot borrow .{0,20}? as mutable more than once

signatures.label: ssl.SSLCertVerificationError: certificate verify failed
TypeError: string indices must be integers
TS2322: Type 'X' is not assignable to type 'Y'
TS2339: Property 'X' does not exist on type 'Y'
signatures.pattern: TS2339|property '.{0,40}?' does not exist on type

signatures.label: TS2345: Argument of type 'X' is not assignable to parameter of type 'Y'
signatures.pattern: TS2345|argument of type .{0,40}? is not assignable to parameter

signatures.label: TS2349: This expression is not callable
TS2307: Cannot find module or its corresponding type declarations
signatures.pattern: TS2307|[Cc]annot find module .* or its corresponding type declarations

signatures.label: TS2304: Cannot find name 'X'
TS7006: Parameter implicitly has an 'any' type
TS2769: No overload matches this call
TS2532: Object is possibly 'undefined'
TS7016: Could not find a declaration file for module 'X'
signatures.pattern: TS7016|could not find a declaration file for module

signatures.label: TS7053: Element implicitly has an 'any' type (index signature)
Uncaught ReferenceError: X is not defined
signatures.pattern: referenceerror: \w+ is not defined|\bis not defined\b

signatures.label: Uncaught TypeError: X is not a function
SyntaxError: Unexpected non-whitespace character after JSON data
UnhandledPromiseRejectionWarning / Unhandled promise rejection
UnicodeDecodeError: 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte
URIError: URI malformed
ValueError: Trailing data
504 (Outdated Optimize Dep)
TypeError: X.map is not a function
signatures.pattern: \.map is not a function|\.(?:filter|forEach|reduce) is not a function

signatures.label: undefined: X
imported and not used: "X"
cannot find module providing package X
signatures.pattern: cannot find module providing package|no required module provides package

signatures.label: error[E0308]: mismatched types
error[E0277]: the trait bound is not satisfied
error[E0597]: does not live long enough
Exception in thread "main" java.lang.ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException
ClassNotFoundException / NoClassDefFoundError
error: cannot find symbol
Go: panic: interface conversion
Rust: called Option::unwrap() on a None value
signatures.pattern: called `Option::unwrap\(\)` on a `None` value|unwrap\(\) on a `None`

signatures.label: java.util.ConcurrentModificationException
Go: declared and not used
signatures.pattern: declared and not used|declared but not used

signatures.label: Rust: error[E0599]: no method named X found
java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space
signatures.pattern: OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space|GC overhead limit exceeded

signatures.label: Kafka: SerializationException: Unknown magic byte!
Kafka: CommitFailedException: Offset commit cannot be completed
signatures.pattern: CommitFailedException|group has already rebalanced|kicked out of the group

signatures.label: Kafka: TimeoutException: Expiring N record(s)
signatures.pattern: Expiring \d+ record\(s\)|has passed since batch creation

signatures.label: Kafka: OffsetOutOfRangeException: Fetch offset is out of range
signatures.pattern: OffsetOutOfRangeException|[Ff]etch offset .* is out of range|out of range for partition

signatures.label: Kafka: Error while fetching metadata: LEADER_NOT_AVAILABLE
signatures.pattern: LEADER_NOT_AVAILABLE|[Ee]rror while fetching metadata with correlation id

signatures.label: java.lang.UnsupportedClassVersionError: class file version 65.0
signatures.pattern: UnsupportedClassVersionError|has been compiled by a more recent version of the Java Runtime|Unsupported major\.minor version

signatures.label: java.lang.NumberFormatException: For input string: "X"
TS2571: Object is of type 'unknown'
signatures.pattern: TS2571|Object is of type 'unknown'|'\w+' is of type 'unknown'|TS18046

signatures.label: TS18048: 'x' is possibly 'undefined'
E11000 duplicate key error collection
signatures.pattern: E11000|duplicate key error collection|duplicate key error index
